name: downloads
label: Downloads: files brought onto this machine from an address (model files from a repository), into one of its places

defaults._doc: A manager names an address and where the file goes; this node fetches it, resuming where a broken download stopped. Outside contact: the address named, and nothing else (no account, no telemetry). allow_hosts: when not empty, only these hosts (and their subdomains) are fetched from - for a closed network, a file server of your own. Nothing is replaced: a name that exists is refused until it is removed.

allow_hosts.label: Only from these hosts
allow_hosts.hint: a list; empty: any host the machine can reach
